name: Episcopal Complex of the Euphrasian Basilica in the Historic Centre of Poreč
description: In the Istrian seaside town of Poreč, Croatia, this cluster of church buildings includes a basilica, an atrium, a baptistery, a bell tower and the bishop's palace. Christians were already worshipping here in the 4th century, and the present basilica is the third church on the spot. Parts of an earlier floor mosaic still lie beneath it, and the church is often called the best preserved early Christian church in the world.
